title: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). translated_title: 单板视觉驾驶：面向机载机器人导航的无注意力深度估计
translated_abstract: 小型地面机器人可以携带一个摄像头和几瓦特的算力，但那些能够将摄像头转化为距离传感器的深度基础模型，却是为GPU规模设计的视觉Transformer。我们将其中的一个模型部署到配备Hailo-8L加速器的树莓派5上——该加速器以整数运算运行所有层，包括注意力层。经过针对性量化的Depth Anything V2会丢失场景的大部分内容，我们测量了原因：在449个token时，91%的softmax权重低于一个int8量化步长，却承载了17-33%的注意力质量。我们的解决方案是蒸馏而非量化。一个从Depth Anything V2-Large（2450万参数）蒸馏而来的无注意力ResNet-34 U-Net学生网络，在芯片上以27.1 FPS运行，其int8输出与其浮点版本几乎完全一致（皮尔逊相关系数0.99993），并且在其模拟庭院的留出测试场景上，它是该芯片上最精确的深度网络（AbsRel为0.269，而对比方法为0.354-0.530）。在真实户外行驶采集的1000个经立体视觉验证的采样点上，它（与浮点教师模型）的差异不可分辨。
tldr: 该论文提出用知识蒸馏而非量化，将无注意力的ResNet-34 U-Net学生模型部署到树莓派5的Hailo-8L加速器上，以27.1 FPS实现芯片上最精确的单目深度估计，使小型机器人能依靠单块板卡的视觉进行导航。
en_tdlr: By distilling Depth Anything V2-Large into an attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net instead of quantizing it, the model runs at 27.1 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-8L accelerator, achieving the most accurate onboard monocular depth estimation on the chip and enabling vision-based navigation for small robots.
